disposition_reason: The paper has a legitimate same-task oddball AUROC endpoint with explicit run-held-out folds, but the exact published numeric baseline and source-matched summary have not been recovered. The current evaluator computes RSA only, so its reconstruction cannot establish a decoding improvement.

source_paper.title: A geometric shape regularity effect in the human brain

evidence.locator: Experiment 4 (MEG): Participants; Preprocessing of MEG signals; Decoding; RSA in sensor space; Fig. 4
evidence.supports: Original run-held-out reference-versus-oddball AUROC and descriptive regularity/RSA analyses, including six directional run splits and participant-wise results.

evidence.locator: Configuration: channels, Maxwell filter, l_freq, h_freq, resample_sfreq
evidence.supports: Source configuration uses MEG channels, Maxwell filtering, 0.1–40 Hz filtering and 250-Hz resampling.

evidence.locator: Sensor RSA construction component scope and holds
evidence.supports: Existing implementation covers sensor RSA, not the historical oddball decoder or an authenticated numeric reference.

target.description: Original ordered component: decode reference versus oddball MEG epochs, train jointly across all eleven shapes and report AUROC separately by shape/time. Regularity correlations and symbolic-versus-CNN RSA remain descriptive companion results, not scores to inflate.

dataset.description: Paper releases the POGS MEG study; registration selects OpenNeuro ds006012 v1.0.1. Exact version-to-published-decoding artifacts and all 158 run identities still need primary data reconciliation.

cohort.description: Twenty healthy adult MEG participants (13 female, ages 21–42); sensor analyses use all twenty. The nineteen-participant source-reconstruction subset is not the sensor-decoding cohort.

split.description: Six directional run folds: even versus odd; first half versus second half; runs 1,2,5,6 versus 3,4,7,8, each in both directions. This is not a new held-out-shape or participant split.

inputs.description: MEG epochs from the passive reference/oddball paradigm; original shapes and rotations/scalings, all-shape training and shape-specific test evaluation.

preprocessing.description: Source preprocessing uses bad-channel detection, Maxwell/SSS, 0.1–40-Hz filtering, 250 Hz, epochs −150 to 1150 ms, SSP and autoreject. Decoding excludes the first six trials of each block and normalizes each epoch; smoothed and unsmoothed branches must remain identifiable.

metric.description: Shape-specific ROC AUROC avoids bias from the approximately 4:20 oddball/reference imbalance. Larger out-of-run AUROC is ordered predictive improvement; a larger correlation with regularity is a different descriptive claim.

aggregation.description: Source reports participant-wise time courses and shape-specific AUROCs, then cluster-selected temporal summaries. Exact numeric baseline arrays, fold averaging, selected cluster and an admissible single primary comparison summary are not yet recovered.

comparison.primary_metric: Original shape-specific run-held-out oddball ROC AUROC, with source time/shape aggregation still unresolved

published_baseline.description: Fig. 4 supplies AUROC time courses, but the reviewed text does not supply the exact numeric comparator and summary required for admission. The reported 428-ms peak latency is not an AUROC baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authentic author rerun is established by this source and static implementation review.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful oddball-decoding gain requires a recovered exact author comparator and an endpoint-specific justification; no arbitrary AUROC increment is supplied.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired participant-level comparison retaining all run folds and shapes after recovering the source endpoint; its confidence procedure and decision rule are not yet specified.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Task-specific biological units described in same_task.aggregation; repeated observations are not independent subjects.
uncertainty.rationale: The six overlapping run contrasts and repeated time points are dependent; participants, not folds or epochs, supply biological replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover and surpass the original decoder under the same twenty-subject cohort, all-shape training, shape-specific test targets, six run-fold directions and input/preprocessing condition.
Preserve both descriptive RSA and geometric-regularity results as separate outputs; do not call a larger biological correlation an algorithm win.
A held-out-shape/participant split or reduced shape set is an extension, even if both methods are rerun on it.
Require a predeclared meaningful AUROC improvement and valid participant-level uncertainty after baseline recovery; reconstruction alone is insufficient.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source results, any future author rerun, and current SOTA are separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked until exact source baseline and summary endpoint are recovered. Then expose only declared original training folds and development feedback; keep final source-test access evaluator-owned.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze preprocessing, model, hyperparameters, source-fold handling and summary rule before final original-task evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Not executable as a paper-win evaluation yet; retain all original participants, shapes, run partitions and published input conditions.
episode.baseline_policy: Do not turn agreement with the existing reconstruction evaluator, stronger statistical significance, a new split, or a local implementation baseline into a source-paper win.

blocking_issues: Recover exact author oddball AUROC arrays and source script/commit that generated the Version-of-Record result.
Reconcile all twenty subjects, original run inventory, source data version and both smoothing branches.
Freeze an original-task summary without selecting favorable time points/shapes; preserve the six original directional run folds.
Implement and validate the historical decoder comparison; justify meaningful effect and paired participant uncertainty; fix concrete access/resource budgets.

legacy.notes: Retain sensor RSA numerical construction as calibration. Its whitened model correlations, temporal significance and reconstructed figure agreement do not establish higher held-out oddball AUROC.
